subject: prd/installer
statement: an attacker serving a malicious bootstrap script (distinct from a tampered binary — the shell executes fetched bytes before any binary verification can run) — vector: bootstrap URL substitution or interception ahead of the checksum step
intent: arbitrary shell on the user's machine
fit_criterion: the documented bootstrap line is a pinned HTTPS URL; the shim fetches the checksum set before executing any fetched byte beyond itself; the getting-started docs state the HTTPS floor and the pinned-URL pattern
